name: Loose Unfinished Pencil Figure Sketch
name_es: Boceto de figura a lápiz suelto e inacabado
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se puede aplicar el estilo gráfico a distintos sujetos o escenas sin alterar su contenido base. Se mantienen el lenguaje visual, la soltura del trazo y el acabado de boceto inacabado.

style.line_quality: loose, gestural, hand-drawn contour lines with visible exploratory strokes and irregular pressure
style.construction: visible construction lines, underdrawing, and open sketch marks that are not fully cleaned
style.shading: light, simple hatching and soft tonal indication only where needed to suggest volume
style.detail_level: low to moderate detail, prioritizing silhouette, gesture, and construction over polished rendering
style.rendering_focus: anatomy study, pose, and garment structure with an intentionally raw sketchbook feel
style.facial_treatment: the face must remain suggested rather than fully defined, with very minimal features, soft indication only, and no highly rendered realism
style.edge_definition: edges should remain open and flexible, avoiding sharp, finished outlines
style.composition_behavior: academic sketchbook aesthetic, cropped or partial figure studies allowed, with an observational and spontaneous feeling
style.overall_look: clean but loose artistic pencil study, elegant, observational, lightly constructed, and intentionally incomplete

notes: Este archivo describe únicamente el estilo gráfico. El resultado debe evitar rostros demasiado definidos o acabados pulidos. La pose específica debe citarse por separado si corresponde.
